test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence. **

Everyone was charmed by her fine dance performance.

options.text: Her fine dance performance has charmed everyone.
Her fine dance performance charmed everyone.
Her fine dance performance was charming to everyone.
Her fine dance performance will charm everyone.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Her fine dance performance charmed everyone.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Simple past tense.
 
• The Simple past in the passive voice has the following form: **Subject + was/were + past participle + by object__**
 
• The Simple past in the active voice has the following form: __**Subject + past participle + object**__
 __
 
• Passive: *A letter was written by him.*
 
• Active: *He wrote a letter.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *Her fine dance performance charmed everyone.*
